headline: Boox announces the Palma 3 with stylus support and a redesign
summary: Two outlets report Boox announcing the Palma 3, a pocket-sized E Ink device gaining stylus support and a new build. One places it among three new devices announced together; the other notes the gap since the last model and a price increase.
